text:
I need to verify the year Edward VIII abdicated.

Edward VIII became King of the United Kingdom in January 1936 following the death of his father, George V. He abdicated in December 1936 to marry Wallis Simpson, an American divorcée, as this marriage was not acceptable to the British establishment and Commonwealth governments at the time. His abdication took effect on December 11, 1936, and he was succeeded by his brother, who became George VI.

Agent 1's answer of 1936 is correct.

Answer: 1936
